standard: Retain the topic only when the Kingdom of God itself occupies the majority of the post, rather than serving as context for another dominant subject.
descriptionBefore: Covers Jesus' proclamation of the coming Kingdom of God, including its apocalyptic meaning, who would enter it, and its implications for ethics, wealth, miracles, and messianic expectations.
descriptionAfter: Examines Jesus' proclamation of the coming Kingdom of God, including its imminent apocalyptic arrival, the judgment and reversal it would bring, who would enter it, and how later Gospel traditions reshaped that expectation.
